comment: EDGE-MUTANT te-000 (FIND-W16-001) bad-txns-vin-empty: vin=[] is wire-representable via the BIP144 marker path (ver 01000000 | marker 00 | flag 01 | nvin 00 | nvout 01 | 1 sat | 51 | lt 00000000 = 22 bytes; Core UnserializeTransaction reads the 0x00 vin count as the marker, 0x01 as the flag, then vin count 0). checkTransaction = some .vinEmpty. MUTANT-TXV-001 (drop vin-empty) returns none -> runner flips pass->fail = killed-RUNNER. NOTE (Core divergence, report-only): Core's deserializer THROWS 'Superfluous witness record' on this exact wire (flags=1 with no witness data, transaction.h UnserializeTransaction) - the codegen reference decoder + W02 lean decodeTx accept it (note-only) and CheckTransaction's vin-empty guard is the defense-in-depth behind the decoder, as FIND-W16-001 says. rawHex = machine-exact wire (rawTx default empty in the record = not ser_judged).

Core-model-AGNOSTIC reject: witness-LESS row (stripped = Core 4*noWitness = 4000004 reject; FIX-TS04 evidence: the base-1000001 fz rows AGREE reject). voutRange row: 1MB wire not carried (record tx built by replication, List.range 99994).map (make_edge_vecs); rawTx default empty = not ser_judged. The accept side of this boundary = ve-002 (s=5, stripped 4000000 = AT the bound). MUT-TXV-003 (+4 loosening) = killed-RUNNER here + killed-TEST (Pins.lean bigW) + killed-PACK (MutationPack.lean bigTx8).
